title: Sunday · Wagner's, lit
logline: The hardware store on the corner, lit, a Sunday evening in February, the week before the strip starts letting it close in the backgrounds. Everything on the shelves. The last time.

panels.composition: Tier 1: Wagner's Hardware on the corner at dusk, windows lit, shelves full through the glass, a man in an apron at the register, the sign whole.

image.notes: The week before dw_2011-02-21. Letter after: WAGNER'S HARDWARE · SINCE 1962.

panels.composition: Tier 2: through the glass, the shelves: bins of nails, coils of rope, the things a town keeps.

panels.composition: Tier 3: the corner from across the street, the store the only lit thing on the block. Held.
